description: Nowledge Mem lifecycle hooks — Context Bundle / Working Memory injection and session capture

hooks.command: ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/nmem-hook-read.sh"; if [ -f "$SCRIPT" ]; then sh "$SCRIPT" --hook; else [ -z "${GROK_SESSION_ID:-}${GROK_HOOK_EVENT:-}${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-}${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}${NMEM_AGENT_ID:-}${NMEM_HOST_AGENT_ID:-}${NMEM_APP_DATA:-}${NMEM_APP_CONFIG_DIR:-}${NMEM_CLI_CONFIG_DIR:-}" ] && { [ -z "${NMEM_SPACE:-${NMEM_SPACE_ID:-}}" ] || [ "${NMEM_SPACE:-${NMEM_SPACE_ID:-}}" = default ]; } && [ -n "${NMEM_AI_NOW_HOME-$HOME/ai-now}" ] && cat "${NMEM_AI_NOW_HOME-$HOME/ai-now}/memory.md" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/nmem-hook-read.sh"; if [ -f "$SCRIPT" ]; then sh "$SCRIPT" --hook --compact; else [ -z "${GROK_SESSION_ID:-}${GROK_HOOK_EVENT:-}${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-}${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}${NMEM_AGENT_ID:-}${NMEM_HOST_AGENT_ID:-}${NMEM_APP_DATA:-}${NMEM_APP_CONFIG_DIR:-}${NMEM_CLI_CONFIG_DIR:-}" ] && { [ -z "${NMEM_SPACE:-${NMEM_SPACE_ID:-}}" ] || [ "${NMEM_SPACE:-${NMEM_SPACE_ID:-}}" = default ]; } && [ -n "${NMEM_AI_NOW_HOME-$HOME/ai-now}" ] && cat "${NMEM_AI_NOW_HOME-$HOME/ai-now}/memory.md" 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\nContext was compacted. Save durable insights before continuing.\n'; fi

PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true)"; ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/nmem-hook-subagent.py"; [ -n "$PY" ] && [ -f "$SCRIPT" ] && "$PY" "$SCRIPT" || true

ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/nmem-hook-read.sh"; if [ -f "$SCRIPT" ]; then sh "$SCRIPT" --hook --event UserPromptSubmit; else printf '%s\n' '[Nowledge Mem] For continuation, review, regression, release, connector, prior-decision, or exact-history work, run one targeted nmem memory or thread search before concluding. Startup briefing is not a substitute. If retrieval fails, say so briefly.'; fi

PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true)"; ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/nmem-hook-save.py"; [ -n "$PY" ] && [ -f "$SCRIPT" ] && "$PY" "$SCRIPT" --event pre-compact || true

PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true)"; ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/nmem-hook-save.py"; [ -n "$PY" ] && [ -f "$SCRIPT" ] && "$PY" "$SCRIPT" --event stop --detach || true

PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true)"; ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/nmem-hook-save.py"; [ -n "$PY" ] && [ -f "$SCRIPT" ] && "$PY" "$SCRIPT" --event subagent-stop --detach || true

PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true)"; ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/nmem-hook-save.py"; [ -n "$PY" ] && [ -f "$SCRIPT" ] && "$PY" "$SCRIPT" --event session-end --detach || true
